prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM. A bright, spacious, stylish contemporary downtown penthouse living room in cream, gold and soft grey. Back wall: wide windows with sheer white curtains letting in soft daylight from behind. A plush cream bouclé sofa stands in the middle of the room with its back to these windows, facing the camera, with silk cushions. In front of it is a round travertine coffee table holding flowers and a tablet stand on a pale rug. Right wall: an open doorway into the kitchen, framed in brushed brass, with a glimpse of white marble counters. Left wall: the opening to the entrance hallway, the way in, beside a low gold-legged console with a mirror. Front wall, behind the camera: a TV wall. Light comes from the window daylight and a modern brass floor lamp beside the sofa. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
